content.short: BloFin's self-custody wallet signs in with a passkey, pays gas in stablecoins and spends through a built-in card.
content.description: BloFin Wallet is the onchain companion to the BloFin exchange, but the keys stay with the user. Instead of writing down a seed phrase, you sign in with a passkey. Swaps and bridges can pay gas in USDC or USDT, so you do not need the native token of every chain. Idle stablecoins can earn yield, and a linked Visa or Mastercard spends straight from the wallet. It covers Ethereum, the major L2s, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Polygon, Solana and Tron.
content.meta: Passkey self-custody wallet that pays gas in stablecoins and spends through a linked card. Explore BloFin Wallet on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
